summary.text: Jennie Gomarlo is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Jennifer Rhodes. She previously served in the House from 2018 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Jennie Gomarlo was first elected to the House in 2018, winning one of the two Cheshire 12 seats and defeating incumbent Jim McConnell, and she took office on December 5, 2018.
She was re-elected in 2020, did not run for re-election in 2022, and left office on December 7, 2022.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Cheshire 17 on September 8, 2026.
